title: Don't Be a Proxy Between Me and Your AI
why_read: An opinion rant about colleagues relaying AI-generated answers instead of their own judgment, with no real technical content.
analysis: This is a personal essay complaining about coworkers who paste AI-generated responses into technical discussions instead of offering their own expertise. It raises a legitimate cultural concern about AI use eroding genuine technical dialogue, but it offers no concrete techniques, data, or systems analysis. It reads more like a workplace etiquette complaint than a technical digest item. The sentiment is relatable but thin on substantive engineering content.
